content:
incident-bot: PAGED: High error rate (5xx) on prod gateway - TLS handshake failures detected. Pager duty triggered.

alex: acked. looking.

priya: seeing spike in 5xx from edge-1, region us-east-1. error rate ~28% last 3m. dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/gateway/errors

tomas: logs show repeated: "tls: handshake failure: remote error: certificate has expired" from proxy -> origin TLS

maria: confirmed with openssl on edge node:
```
$ openssl s_client -connect backend.internal:443 -servername backend.internal
---
Certificate chain
 0 s:/CN=internal.example
   i:/CN=redwood-ca
---
notAfter=Mar 10 12:00:00 2026 GMT
```
cert expired 03/10/2026

alex: which cert? service cert or client cert? this looks like origin cert expired.

priya: origin cert (service-to-service) used for mTLS rotated last year; thumbprint mismatch on rotation logs earlier tonight.

eva: also hitting 502/524 behind gateway for clients because TLS handshake failing upstream.

ops-bot: runbook link: https://runbooks/internal/tls-incident. steps: fallback to backup cert, rotate, restart proxy

tomas: starting manual fallback: uploading backup cert from vault to origin pool, will reconfigure origin group to use backup.

maria: pushing command to edge node:
```
$ curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://edge-admin/v1/origins/rotate -d '{"origin":"backend","cert":"backup-v2"}'
```

priya: traffic routed to origin group with backup cert. monitoring...

alex: canary: sent 20 requests, 19/20 success, 1 timeout. good sign.

incident-bot: metric update: handshake error rate dropped from 28% -> 4% in 4m :thumbsup: 

maria: restarting proxy services on edge-1 to clear stale sessions: `systemctl restart redwood-proxy` (done)

tomas: coordinating with platform team to rotate the expired cert in the CA store. priya, alex — can you run the cert rotation job asap?

priya: kicked rotation job, it will push new certs to vault and update origin configs in a controlled canary (region by region)

alex: customer impact: approx 12 customers in us-east had degraded requests (retries succeeded for most). flagged 3 SRE pager tickets for next 24h follow-up.

eva: reached out to trust & security: no compromise, just expiry. they'll assist with telemetry to verify no other certs near expiry.

maria: oncall handoff at 00:30 UTC — next oncall: eva. leaving notes: origin cert expired, we used backup cert, rotation job in progress, monitor handshake error rate and customer retries.

eva: acked. I'll take 00:30-04:30 UTC. watching alerts + postmortem.

alex: creating incident ticket / postmortem placeholder https://issues/redwood/INC-2026

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated -> reduced customer impact. follow-up: postmortem due in 48h, assign to priya, tags: tls, cert-expiry, mitigation

priya: action items: 1) audit cert expiry pipeline 2) add expiry alert 30d prior to CA 3) automate fallback activation

tomas: adding logs and commands used to the incident channel for later copying into postmortem.

eva: thanks all. will run a full sweep of cert inventory and confirm new cert validity. ping me if alerts reappear.

alex: resolved for now. closing retire map. :white_check_mark:
